title: Turkey Sausage, Spinach & Feta Egg White Scramble
subtitle: A leaner scramble built on egg whites, turkey sausage, spinach, and feta.
description: Egg whites scramble with browned turkey sausage, wilted spinach, and crumbled feta for a savory, leaner breakfast with a Mediterranean-leaning flavor. It holds well on the line and reheats cleanly for a next-shift breakfast.

steps.title: Brown the turkey sausage
steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown turkey sausage, breaking it into crumbles, 8–9 minutes until cooked through.

steps.title: Soften the onion and spinach
steps.instruction: Add onion to the pan with the sausage and cook until softened, about 4 minutes. Add spinach and cook just until wilted, 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Scramble in the egg whites
steps.instruction: Lower heat to medium-low. Pour egg whites over the sausage mixture and stir gently until just set — egg whites firm up faster than whole eggs, so pull the pan a little early.

steps.title: Finish with feta
steps.instruction: Fold in crumbled feta off the heat so it stays soft rather than melting completely into the eggs.

steps.title: Hold and serve
steps.instruction: Hold covered on low heat up to 10 minutes if service is staggered. Serve directly from the pan.

stationWorkflow: Brown sausage and soften vegetables before adding egg whites so the pan isn't overcrowded.
Scramble egg whites gently and pull them slightly underdone — they keep setting off the heat.
Fold feta in last so it stays in soft crumbles instead of melting away.
cleanupNotes: Wipe the pan while still warm — cooked egg white sets hard once it cools completely.
Wash cutting boards immediately after raw sausage prep.
leftovers: Reheat gently on low power or in a covered skillet over low heat to keep the eggs from turning rubbery.
